newIntroHighest: The highest version so far is {{highest}} — the new one must be greater.
newIntroFirst: The contract has no version yet — this will be the first.
emptyWriter: No versions yet — add the first document
notFound: This version does not exist (or was deleted).
gone: This version no longer exists — reload the page
blockedBySyntax: The document does not parse — fix the syntax error before saving.
readyHint: Saving stores a DRAFT; soft findings can be waived, syntax errors cannot.
saveInvalid: The version was rejected — see the details

transitionConflict: That transition is not allowed from the version's current state

field.title: Document title
field.startFromHint: Copy a stored version's document as the starting point

DEPRECATED.title: Deprecate this version?
DEPRECATED.body: Version {{version}} will be marked deprecated. Consumers should move to a newer version; this cannot be undone.

RETIRED.title: Retire this version?
RETIRED.body: Version {{version}} will be retired — it stays in the history but is no longer in circulation. This cannot be undone.

validation.versionNotAbove: The version must be greater than {{highest}}
validation.contentTooLarge: The document is larger than 2 MiB

saveAnyway.title: Save with findings?
saveAnyway.intro: The checks found {{count}} blocking finding(s). You can save anyway — the findings stay on the version until the document is fixed.

source.urlInvalid: Only public https:// URLs can be fetched
source.urlFailedNetwork: Fetch failed. Check your connection and try again.

diff.title: Compare versions of {{name}}
diff.intro: A line-by-line comparison of two stored documents.
diff.needTwo: Two versions are needed for a comparison.

deleteBody: Version {{version}} of "{{name}}" will be deleted. Only drafts can be deleted.
deleteNotDraft: Only a DRAFT version can be deleted — this one is part of the contract's history.

sync.title: Sync {{version}} from its source
sync.inSync: Covenant and the repository are in sync
sync.diffLabel: Changes between the stored document and the repository copy
sync.repoBroken: The repository copy does not parse — fix it there first.
sync.findingsWarning_one: The repository copy carries {{count}} finding — syncing stores it anyway.
sync.findingsWarning_other: The repository copy carries {{count}} findings — syncing stores them anyway.
sync.overwriteWarning: Syncing overwrites the stored document with the repository copy shown above. Edits made only in Covenant will be lost.
sync.lockedHint: This version is published, so its document cannot change — start a new version from the repository copy instead.
sync.newVersion: New version from the repository copy
sync.invalid: The repository copy was rejected — see the details

sourceLink.title: Source of {{version}}
sourceLink.hint: A public https:// link to the document in its repository (a GitHub/GitLab blob or raw URL). Leave empty to unlink.
sourceLink.invalid: Only https:// URLs without credentials can be linked
